# Report and track equipment issues

## Problem

There is no workflow for teachers or activity staff to report equipment problems and follow their progress toward resolution.

## Proposed outcome

Allow authorized staff to report an equipment issue and designated maintainers to update its status.

## Acceptance criteria

- A report can include a description, location, date, and optional related activity.
- Authorized maintainers can assign or update the issue status (for example, open, in progress, resolved).
- The reporter can see status updates.
- Issue history is retained when the status changes.
- The system does not expose unrelated student or staff information in issue views.
- If equipment management is not enabled for a deployment, its UI is not presented as an active feature.
